title: Provably Efficient Self-Calibrating Quantum Fault Tolerance
abstract: arXiv:2608.05686v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Quantum error correction protects logical information only when every physical operation remains below the fault-tolerance threshold, a condition that must be maintained continuously rather than only at the initial calibration. In practice, however, analog control parameters inevitably drift because of environmental fluctuations. As future fault-tolerant quantum computations are expected to run for days or even months, interrupting computation for repeated recalibration becomes fundamentally impractical. A promising alternative is to integrate calibration directly into computation by repurposing syndrome measurements as a calibration signal (Sivak et al, Nature 2026), but whether such self-calibration can be achieved with provable efficiency remains an open question. translated_title: 可证明高效的自校准量子容错
translated_abstract: 量子纠错仅在每个物理操作保持在容错阈值以下时保护逻辑信息，这一条件必须持续维持，而不仅仅是在初始校准时。然而，在实践中，由于环境波动，模拟控制参数不可避免地会发生漂移。由于未来容错量子计算预计运行数天甚至数月，中断计算进行重复校准从根本上变得不切实际。一个有前景的替代方案是，通过将综合征测量重新用作校准信号（Sivak等人，Nature 2026），将校准直接集成到计算中，但这种自校准能否以可证明的效率实现仍然是一个开放性问题。在此，我们为这种自校准量子容错建立了理论框架。我们证明，对于一类广泛的由控制引起的错误，检测...
tldr: 本文首次为自校准量子容错建立了可证明高效的理论框架，证明对于多种控制引起的错误，可通过重新利用综合征测量实现持续校准，无需中断计算。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes the first provably efficient theoretical framework for self-calibrating quantum fault tolerance, demonstrating that continuous calibration can be achieved by repurposing syndrome measurements for a broad class of control-induced errors without interrupting computation.
